stories.title: How can people manage anxiety caused by artificial intelligence?
stories.simple_summary: People are feeling worried or stressed about artificial intelligence, and there are ways to help manage those feelings.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're nervous about AI changing your work or life, knowing how to handle that stress is useful — this is about your peace of mind.

stories.title: New York rolls out new AI regulations as technology rapidly evolves
stories.simple_summary: New York State is creating new rules to control how AI companies operate as the technology grows.
stories.why_it_matters: Rules might eventually protect you from AI misuse, but this is mainly about government catching up — no immediate action needed for you.

stories.title: The man who built Apple’s stores doesn’t buy Silicon Valley’s bet on AI shopping
stories.simple_summary: The person who designed Apple's stores thinks Apple should focus on real people helping customers, not just AI technology doing the work.
stories.why_it_matters: This is one expert's opinion about retail — mostly relevant to investors and large retailers, not something affecting your small business right now.

stories.title: California tightens rules on AI data center energy and water use
stories.simple_summary: California made new laws so that AI data centers (huge computer facilities) have to pay for the extra water and electricity they use, instead of passing those costs to regular residents.
stories.why_it_matters: This might help keep your electric bill from rising due to AI company costs, though the effect will take time to show up.

stories.title: Op-eds, academic articles by Provost Santiago Schnell flagged as ‘AI-written’ by ‘near-zero error’ AI detector Pangram
stories.simple_summary: An AI checker said that a university leader's written papers look like they were written by AI, but the leader says they wrote them.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI checkers sometimes make mistakes — be skeptical if anyone claims something is definitely AI-written without strong proof.

stories.title: OpenAI forms math advisory group as its AI resolves more than 100 open problems
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's AI solved over 100 math problems that experts couldn't solve before, and they're forming a group to guide this math work.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to mathematicians and investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Wall Street Is Growing Skeptical of the Data Center Boom
stories.simple_summary: Wall Street investors are becoming less confident that the huge investment in AI data centers will pay off.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to stock investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Sting reveals he doesn’t see artificial intelligence as a competitor
stories.simple_summary: The musician Sting said he doesn't view AI as competition to human artists.
stories.why_it_matters: This is one musician's personal view — not news that affects your daily life.

stories.title: Discover what’s next: 5 days left to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket
stories.simple_summary: TechCrunch is advertising a discount on conference tickets before prices go up.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an advertisement, not news — only relevant if you want to attend a tech conference.

stories.title: Meta’s Muse is outpacing ChatGPT’s early mobile launch
stories.simple_summary: Meta released a new AI helper app called Muse that more people downloaded quickly than people did with ChatGPT when it first came out on phones.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech investors — it shows Meta's AI product is popular, but doesn't directly affect your business.

stories.title: Meta’s AI agent has been blocked from using Amazon.com
stories.simple_summary: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse app from accessing Amazon.com, so the AI can't help people shop on Amazon.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a business dispute between tech giants — nothing you need to worry about.

stories.title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI created an advisory group to guide its artificial intelligence work on mathematics.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to math researchers and OpenAI investors — nothing affecting your daily life.
